answer_1.quote: TDCA employs a contrastive labelconditioned generation approach, which fine-tunes LLMs to generate texts that not only accurately reflect each label in the sampled label combinations but also emulate the style of the original dataset.
tasks: Other:Conditional Text Generation for Data Augmentation

answer_2.quote: Performance assessments were carried out on the EurLex-4K, MeSH-12K, and Wiki10-30K on various expansion ratios to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed TDCA compared to EDA, BT, and CA.
